_comment: T-381, the tutorial slides' and the pause screen's trick list's text (HUD and menus, Content, 'Tutorial slides and trick list'); the UI tickets read it, no text in code. Every line scored 8 or more in the style loop (T-381's Style review). Keys: slide1.*, slide2.*, slide3.*, trick.<id> (reused word for word from the trick popups and recap_text.json), button.*, checkbox.*, arrow.*. Each entry has a '<key>_comment' line saying where it appears. T-484 (the redrawn four-slide tutorial, HUD and menus, Decisions, 'The tutorial slides are redrawn, with clips of the real car'): new keys kicker.*, slide1.title, slide1.key_*, slide1.drift_rule, slide2.title, slide2.step*, slide2.clip_ramp, slide3.title, slide3.missions, slide4.*, button.skip, all scored 8 or more in T-484's Style review. Headlines, labels and captions are stored in sentence case (the style loop's label kind); the slides show them in capitals in the display font, so the UI upcases them for display (trick.* are stored in capitals, as popups).

slide1.controls: W accelerate, S brake/reverse, A left, D right. Live viewers want confidence. Fake it.
slide1.controls_comment: UNUSED since T-484 (the redrawn slides no longer show it; the UI ticket removes its use). Was: Slide 1 (the controls), first line: what W, A, S and D do.
slide1.drift: Accelerate while turning and the car drifts on its own. No drift button, zero friction.
slide1.drift_comment: UNUSED since T-484 (the redrawn slides no longer show it; the UI ticket removes its use). Was: Slide 1 (the controls), second line under the controls: accelerating while turning drifts the car.
slide1.title: Drive
slide1.key_w_comment: Slide 1: the small label on the W keycap.
slide1.key_a_comment: Slide 1: the small label on the A keycap.
slide1.key_s_comment: Slide 1: the small label on the S keycap.
slide1.key_d_comment: Slide 1: the small label on the D keycap.
slide1.drift_rule_comment: Slide 1: the drift rule under the keys, written with the W as part of the line (the UI may draw the W as a keycap and split the line on '+' and '=').

slide2.chain: Tricks bring live viewers. Live viewers bring subs.
slide2.chain_comment: UNUSED since T-484 (the redrawn slides no longer show it; the UI ticket removes its use). Was: Slide 2 (the loop), first line under the trick list: tricks bring viewers, viewers bring subs.
slide2.gift: Every sub goal brings a gift pack: a weapon that keeps enemies away and the stream alive.
slide2.gift_comment: UNUSED since T-484 (the redrawn slides no longer show it; the UI ticket removes its use). Was: Slide 2 (the loop), second line under the trick list: a sub goal brings a gift pack with a weapon that helps survive and keeps enemies away.
slide2.title: Tricks bring gift packs
slide2.step1_title_comment: Slide 2, step 1 title (the trick clip step).
slide2.step1_caption_comment: Slide 2, step 1 caption under its title.
slide2.step2_title_comment: Slide 2, step 2 title (the live viewers counter rising).
slide2.step2_caption_comment: Slide 2, step 2 caption under its title.
slide2.step3_title_comment: Slide 2, step 3 title (the sub goal ring).
slide2.step3_caption_comment: Slide 2, step 3 caption under its title.
slide2.step4_caption: A new weapon that fires itself.
slide2.step4_caption_comment: Slide 2, step 4 caption under its title.
slide2.clip_ramp_comment: Slide 2: the caption under the ramp clip, joining two trick names word for word (trick.airtime and trick.air_one_eighty). The other two clip captions are trick.extended_drift and trick.alternate_drift, read from trick.*, not repeated here.

slide3.goal: Chain tricks for gift packs. Be maxed out for the kaiju at 1 minute left. Peak content.
slide3.goal_comment: UNUSED since T-484 (the redrawn slides no longer show it; the UI ticket removes its use). Was: Slide 3 (the goal): chain tricks to get the most weapons and be strongest when the kaiju arrives with 1 minute left.
slide3.title: Missions power your car
slide3.missions: The notebook on the left gives you one mission at a time: clear it, then pick a driving power-up.
slide3.missions_comment: Slide 3: the one line beside the notebook page and the four driving power-ups. The notebook's sample lines and the power-up names come from screen_texts.json, not from here.

trick.comment: Slide 2 (the loop) and the pause screen's trick list panel: the name beside each trick's illustration, one per trick id in game/docs/driving/tricks.md. Reused word for word from the trick popups (recap_text.json trick.*), so each trick has one name.

button.start_comment: Slide 3's button that starts the run (the board's word is 'Start'; the style loop's pick 'Go live' scored 9, a proposal for the playtest).
button.trick_list_comment: The pause screen's button that opens the trick list panel.
button.back_comment: The trick list panel's back control, returning to the pause screen.
button.skip_comment: The Skip control at the top right of every slide; jumps to the last slide (shown in capitals). Go live and Don't show again keep button.start and checkbox.dont_show.

checkbox.dont_show_comment: Slide 3, the checkbox label beside the Start button: ticked, the slides don't appear on later Starts.

arrow.left_comment: The left arrow's accessible label (tooltip) on the tutorial slides.
arrow.right_comment: The right arrow's accessible label (tooltip) on the tutorial slides.

kicker.pattern_comment: Above every slide's headline: the slide number out of the total, then that slide's kicker topic below. Built by code from this pattern (not scored; it holds no wording).

slide4.title: Survive the stream
slide4.kaiju_comment: Slide 4: the label on the timeline's last-minute zone, beside the kaiju drawing. The times (8:00, 4:00, 1:00) are built by code from numbers.
